required_conditions: Use a diacritic-preserving whole-surface guard before accent-insensitive exact and fuzzy lookup.
Canonicalize case, Unicode composition, whitespace, and Romanian cedilla/comma variants.
Apply the guard to ordinary resolution, Contexto fallback/advice, and Lanț local visible-neighbor resolution.
Denied forms must not mutate score, guess history, or movement and must not suggest Paste as a correction.

evidence.finding: Paște/Paști names the holiday; articulated forms are Paștele/Paștile.
The plural of pastă is unaccented paste.
Pastă has plural paste; paste făinoase denotes pasta products.
Accented forms belong to holiday and recorded consecrated-food senses, not pasta.

demonstrated_code_risks: Accent-folded normalization makes paște collide with paste.
Current suggestions offer Paste for Paște.
Contexto can fall through to unrelated projection suggestions after KG rejection.
Lanț local visible-neighbor matching can select pasta before generic resolver guards.
limitations: Independent agent review, not a human SME review; direct doom.lingv.ro UI unavailable, so source-specific DOOM entries hosted by dexonline were used; no repository edits.
